what.text: People from Syria were displaced internally and to host countries including Türkiye, Germany, Lebanon, Jordan, and Iraq.
In 2025, there were 4865764 refugees from Syria across all host countries.
In 2025, Türkiye hosted 2347756 refugees from Syria.

why.text: Conflict episodes involved the Government of Syria against Syrian insurgents, PYD, IS, and SDF.
Conflict also involved the Government of Israel against the Government of Syria in the Golan Heights.
People were also forced to move by disaster events inside the country.

when.text: The refugee count was 1200 in 1968 and reached 19931 in 2011.
Refugee totals peaked at 6848865 in 2021 and stood at 4865764 in 2025.
New conflict displacement movements were recorded at 156000 in 2011 and 2400000 in 2012.

how.text: Refugees are counted at the end of the year under UNHCR's mandate.
Disaster displacement measures count movements rather than individual people.
Internal displacement is reported by both UNHCR and IDMC.
